title: Can I BEAT a Chess Cheater?
summary: He joins a streamer's unrated bullet arena tournament because a suspicious low-rated account is leading; plays the streamer and various 800-1600 players, gets paired with the suspect, and ends up winning the tournament (last game aborted at time-out). The suspect account is shown closed for fair-play violations.
rules: Normal chess, bullet time control, arena tournament (unrated).

opponent.name: issagoat2304 (suspected cheater)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatar; thumbnail shows a chess.com 'account closed for fair play' card.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board, bullet clocks; streamer overlay segments.

current_impl_issues: 'classic' persona mode is fine as a fallback; could optionally emulate a 'cheater' bot that plays engine-strength moves (very strong) - there is no variant.
evidence: Transcript 0:01 'streamer host an arena tournament... suspiciously low-rated player in first place... Bullet'; 'it is unrated'; 'three for three'; '1600 rated player', 'rated 800'; [23:26] 'the game does get aborted and we do end up winning the tournament'. Frames (visual_b): issagoat2304 (2008), fair-play closed card.
not_playable_reason: Normal bullet chess in a streamer's (PJ) unrated chess.com arena tournament, hunting a suspiciously low-rated leader (issagoat2304, 2008) later closed for fair play. No variant rules.
